description: GenHTTP end to end on the ioxide io_uring engine: the published GenHTTP Gateway image (genhttp/gateway, engine: ioxide) terminates TLS + h2 (gateway-64) and QUIC + h3 (gateway-h3) on 8443, serves /static/* from disk and forwards /baseline2, /json and /async-db over loopback HTTP/1.1 through GenHTTP's reverse proxy to the genhttp-ioxide image, unchanged (same Dockerfile), which compresses /json itself when the edge forwards Accept-Encoding.
